facts.material: famotidine (histamine H2 receptor antagonist) in oral suspension
facts.function: therapeutic medicament for duodenal/gastric ulcer, GERD, erosive esophagitis, Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
facts.form: oral suspension 40 mg/5 mL, in dosage form
facts.end_use: human medical treatment of digestive disorders

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3004 covers medicaments for therapeutic use put up in measured doses or in forms or packings for retail sale; the oral suspension in dosage form qualifies
GRI 6: statistical suffix under Medicaments primarily affecting the digestive system: Containing famotidine or its salts (current 2026 Rev 20 tree, .54)

rejected_alternatives.reason: bulk famotidine chemical; this product is in dosage form
famotidine suffix cited in N339838 under the earlier tree; current revision places famotidine at .54
residual digestive line; a specific famotidine line exists

classification.rationale: Famotidine oral suspension in dosage form is a medicament of heading 3004, classified in 3004.90.92 as other medicaments. NY N339838 (in force) placed famotidine injection in dosage form in 3004.90.92 under the famotidine digestive-system line. In the current revision that statistical line is 3004.90.92.54, confirmed as a leaf by hts_navigate.
